__COMMENT__: This file documents the exact JSON payloads used in the Dehla Pakad WebSocket engine.

CLIENT_TO_SERVER.Description: Sent from the browser to the Java server. Handled by PlayerAction.java

SERVER_TO_CLIENT.Description: Sent from Java to the browser. Handled by GameStateUpdate.java

Payload_Structure.myToken: String (UUID to be saved in localStorage)
Payload_Structure.isPaused: boolean (True if trick is resolving or someone disconnected)
currentTrickCards: String (Array of cards currently on table)
trickPlayerNames: String (Array of names corresponding to currentTrickCards)
Payload_Structure.accumulatedPileSize: Integer (Count of cards currently hidden in the pile)
historyTeamA: Integer (Array of points earned per round)
historyTeamB: Integer (Array of points earned per round)
